people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

translations.web: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
translations.bsb: When the men heard this, they were enraged and began shouting, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
translations.kjv: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
